name: CONTROL: Rivat-Sargos system vs the secondary-literature misquote c < 2817/2425
comment: Negative control. Identical atom table to rs_pns.json; the ONLY change is the declared expected threshold, set to gamma* = 2425/2817 as transmitted by part of the secondary literature (e.g. arXiv:2304.10119) instead of the paper's own 2426/2817. The certificate must FAIL, and must fail at exactly the slice gamma = 2426/2817, where the system produces a facet witness that the misquoted threshold says should not exist. Demonstrates the audit verdict on a real transmission error rather than a synthetic mutation.

HB-typeII.provenance: Heath-Brown [7] type II bound, valid x^{1-gamma} <= N <= x^{5gamma-4} (Section 5). Sole genuine cap: nu <= 5gamma-4 (left edge covered by the choice alpha = 1-gamma).

Rivat-thesis-typeI.provenance: Rivat thesis Thm 5.10 [15]: type I bound valid for N >= x^{3(1-gamma)} (Section 5). Fail: nu <= 3-3gamma.

RS-T1.provenance: The paper's new type I' estimate, Theoreme 1 strength (Sections 6-11 + Amelioration, using Sargos's fifth-derivative criterion, Lemme 10). Caps: nu <= (939gamma-761)/143 (main, Section 11 improved), nu <= gamma-1/2 (Section 7 diagonal + Section 11 HK^{1/2} term), nu <= 3gamma-2 (Section 7 B-transform errors), nu <= (5gamma+9)/33 (Lemme 10 applicability |I|lambda^{7/16} >> 1). Fail = nu >= any cap.

RS-T2.provenance: Same machinery at Theoreme 2 strength (Section 11 with Lemme 9, the unimproved fifth-derivative criterion). Caps: nu <= (147gamma-119)/23 (first term), nu <= (597gamma-469)/133 (second term), nu <= gamma-1/2, nu <= 3gamma-2. Fail = nu >= any cap.

theoreme-2-toolkit.note: Without the Amelioration (Sargos Lemme 10), the toolkit is Theoreme 2's; the paper states c < 441/380 there, i.e. threshold gamma* = 380/441.

pre-RS-toolkit.note: Without the paper's new estimate entirely, coverage of type I' stops at nu = 5gamma-4, reproducing the Liu-Rivat threshold c < 15/13 quoted in Section 2.
